check: Depollution completed before dismantling (fuel, oils, coolant, refrigerant, battery, airbags)
source: Environment Protection (End-of-Life Vehicles) Rules, 2025; RVSF operating norms

check: Certificate of Deposit issued and vehicle deregistered before dismantling
source: Motor Vehicles (Registration and Functions of Vehicle Scrapping Facility) Rules, 2021

check: Weighbridge record of steel sent for recycling (basis for EPR certificate)
source: ELV Rules 2025, EPR on steel recovered

check: Hazardous fractions (oil, battery, refrigerant) sent to an authorised recycler with manifest
source: Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules; ELV Rules 2025

check: Every harvested component traceable to its source vehicle
Every reused part graded against a documented limit, with measurement evidence
Reused / remanufactured parts labelled so they cannot be mistaken for new
source: FTC guides on rebuilt/remanufactured auto parts (disclosure principle)

check: Every engineer override logged with a reason
Catalytic converter sent to an authorised PGM recycler
